Every correction and its exact page location is logged in raw/corrections-log.json; the corrected page-by-page text this build reads is cached in raw/corrected-pages.json, and the chapter-boundary page numbers derived from it are in raw/chapter-boundaries.json.

Wikisource's own <section begin="sN"/>...<section end="sN"/> markers reliably delimit chapters 1-13 (pages 307-337); no such markup exists anywhere in the source past that point.
